Finance
Securely connect your accounts so Grok can help with questions about
your spending, subscriptions, balances, and investments.
About this Connector
See your finances in chat
Ask about balances, recentspending, subscriptions, and
investments across linked accounts.
Ô Your credentials stay private
xAI does not store or view any bank account or password
credentials.
Read-only access
A financial connection is read-only, which means it can't be
used to move money into or out of bank accounts.
Third-party connectors are not built or maintained by xAl. Use caution when
granting access to external services. Review the permissions before
connecting. Usage is subject to the xAI Privacy Policy-
